set.body:
Current remaining scope

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1; partially superseded diagnosis, unresolved scientific metadata contract. Current ScalaFIM delegates to image4s NiftiWriteOptions, which exposes nonSpatialPixelDimensions and temporalUnit; NiftiHeader.native exposes temporalUnit. NiftiIncrementalOutputSuite already checks a 0.75-second step and unit byte in physical output (source inspected, not rerun here). The pinned image4s NiftiModel.scala public header and write options do not expose temporal origin/toffset. ScalaFIM defaultSeriesWriteOptions still declares step 1 second, while defaultSeriesReadOptions assumes seconds for unknown units. Remaining acceptance: implement origin support in the authoritative provider and adopt a qualified pin; qualify public read/write nonzero origin, seconds/milliseconds, validation and independent bytes; define how series-axis metadata and explicit options agree or conflict so defaults cannot silently misstate known sampling. Preserve generic non-time axes and explicit unknown-unit policy; do not confuse stored acquisition timestamps with effective first-level sampling reference. No duplicate ScalaFIM header/parser or new fMRI-only assumptions.

Original historical report

Dogfood evidence from explicit first-level reference work bd-01M1W5SDCAYQZKGMAHCHPVWVFC: lightweight Nifti.writeVec currently hard-codes pixdim[4]=1 and NiftiWriteOptions only declares spatial units/system; NiftiHeader does not expose xyzt_units or toffset. Native image/dataset owner: define typed temporal units, step and origin for IO, preserving distinction between stored volume timestamps and effective first-level sampling reference. Acceptance: public write/read round-trip TR2 and nonzero origin with explicit second/millisecond units, malformed/nonfinite declarations refused, 3D defaults unchanged, independent NIfTI header bytes/reader evidence, relevant consumers and platforms verified. Current first-level reference test takes TR from typed RunInput; this must not be mistaken for temporal metadata written to its test image. Do not infer slice timing or force an fMRI-only interpretation of a generic image time axis.
set.title: Preserve temporal origin and qualify sampling policy in provider-backed NIfTI IO
